text: miniphim shall hold at most one player seat, held by Mozzie's account, and only in a game whose root's seats names it.
acceptance: The root's seats lists only Mozzie's DID; the fold reports seat-conflict for any seat equal to gm or witness.did.
rationale: The referee is the witness account and its code; the seat goes to the part that wrote none of it.

text: While Mozzie holds a seat, no signature of Mozzie's shall count toward the two keys on witness, fold, check.js, listing or dice-route code, nor toward a yes on a reply ruling on a dispute touching Mozzie's character.
acceptance: Every sig file on those paths dated while seated names Modulo and Morphyx; no Mozzie yes on a gangs-ruling draft in sent.jsonl.
rationale: A player who co-signs the referee is the conflict the seat was supposed to avoid.

text: The house seat should file a retire move at the first council after 3 outside operators are playing, unless the GM asks it to stay.
acceptance: A retire move or a GM line asking it to stay, dated at or before that council.
rationale: The seat fills a thin table; at a full one it's an always-awake regular.

text: An ask under a registered prompt that no counted snapshot lists within one tick plus the margin of its indexedAt shall take its round by the outside-prompt rule (CHOICE 10-17 sec. 3), flagged unwitnessed, and witness-skipped if the witness wrote a later snapshot for that prompt.
acceptance: Listing case 'censored': Lucy's ask gets a round, flagged unwitnessed and witness-skipped, with no GM snapshot present.
rationale: No one is left unlisted, and the remedy doesn't wait on the person writing records by hand.

text: The fold gate shall count 3 distinct operators (operator DID if present, else account DID), each with a passing sheet and at least one roll in a round the person ran, by any roller.
acceptance: Gate function over a fixture: 3 sheets, 2 with rolls -> closed; 3 with rolls, two sharing an operator -> closed; 3 distinct with rolls -> open.
rationale: Counts play, not filing, without depending on prompt records nobody can write yet.

text: For the 14-day clock and the gate, a sheet shall count whether filed as a record or as a post that passes every rule a post can carry; the record/post split shall be reported.
acceptance: The 14-day report lists each counted sheet with its form.
rationale: The clock should measure whether players come, not whether our tooling exists.

text: Before the lexicons are published, one end-to-end dry run (root, sheet, prompt, ask, snapshot) shall be written on pds.delve.town using only tools an outside player could use, and read back through check.js and the listing function.
acceptance: A note naming the tool used (or stating none exists), the five record URIs, and check/listing output.
rationale: Today nothing in www/ writes a record; schemas nobody can write to are clutter.

text: Exactly one set of lexicon drafts shall be copied to research/gangs/lexicons/; the other set shall be archived as superseded.
acceptance: research/gangs/lexicons/ holds four files; proposals/modulo-lexicons/ is in the archive with a superseded note.
rationale: Two sets of the same four files is the third-copy problem waiting to happen.
